# Tester Exchange

> Gets Android developers the 12 testers × 14 days Google Play requires
> before a new personal developer account can publish to production. Testers are real people on their own
> phones; a companion Android app verifies each day they opened the app (30+ seconds), and Google reviews
> exactly this engagement. 1 credit = 1 verified tester-day. A 12-tester campaign costs 180 credits, held in
> escrow and refunded if unused. Credits are earned by testing other apps or bought (US$7 / 6 testers, $12 / 12 testers,
> $14 / 15 testers; card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay).

## Fastest path for a developer (3 steps)
1. Paste the Google Play link at https://testerexchange.com/ and pick a pack (or test other apps for free).
2. Pay. The test starts automatically when the payment lands.
3. Tap "Connect Google Play": we add testerexchange-testers@googlegroups.com to the app's closed testing tracks via the
   Play Developer API. Or add that group by hand: Play Console → Closed testing → Testers → Google Groups.

## Fastest path for a tester
- Download https://testerexchange.com/tester-exchange.apk, sign in with Google; tests are assigned automatically,
  each needs one tap to install from Google Play. 1 verified day = 1 credit.

## Bring your own testers (free)
- A developer shares https://testerexchange.com/t/<package> with friends. Friends who sign up there, install the app
  and the Tester Exchange companion app are verified like any tester and fill the 12 seats; no credits move.
  Credits pay only for the seats friends and the circle don't fill ("fill from exchange" on /start or /apps).
- MCP tools: friends_status, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange (token).
  agent_call actions: friends, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange (token).

## Swap circles (free)
- Developers join a circle; it starts at 6 members, or on Monday 01:05 UTC with at least 3, whichever comes first.
  Everyone tests everyone else's app for 14 days, free; friends and credits fill the rest of the 12.
  Needs the Tester Exchange Android app on the phone. Start at https://testerexchange.com/start
- MCP tools: swap_circle_status (public), join_swap_circle, my_swap_circle, leave_swap_circle.
  agent_call actions: circle (public), join_circle, my_circle, leave_circle.

## Pages
- Live list of open closed tests: https://testerexchange.com/tests/
- Closed testing guide (14 languages): https://testerexchange.com/guide/

## For AI agents
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no OAuth): https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
  Auth: header `Authorization: Bearer tx_…` or `?token=tx_…`. Public tools (about, platform_stats, pricing,
  list_open_tests) work without a token. Users create tokens at https://testerexchange.com/api
- HTTP API (one endpoint): POST https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/agent_call
  headers: `apikey: sb_publishable_OwXT7OfwIGkuIn420mavVA_MsAkzZGf` (public key), `Content-Type: application/json`
  body: {"p_token": "tx_…" | null, "p_action": "help", "p_args": {}}
  Actions: help, stats, pricing, open_tests (public); me, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign, campaign,
  add_testers, set_status, join, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits (token).
- OpenAPI: https://testerexchange.com/openapi.json
- Agent docs: https://testerexchange.com/agents/
- What an agent can't do: the 14 days of real use on a phone, and paying (checkout needs a human).

## Facts (October 2026)
- Personal Google Play developer accounts created after 13 Nov 2023 need a closed test with at least 12 opted-in
  testers for 14 continuous days, then apply for production access with a questionnaire.
- The requirement was 20 testers until December 2024.
